attributes.board_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health – Occupational Therapist Licensure

rules.accepted_credit_types: 1 contact hour (min. 50 minutes) per hour of courses, seminars, programs, structured didactic in-service and scientific meetings directly related to OT; face-to-face or home study with a proficiency exam (distance/internet allowed). Also: teaching at an ACOTE school (max 6), NBCOT exam passed 5+ years after graduation (12), presentations, exhibits (max 12), publications (10 per peer-reviewed article/chapter, 5 per non-peer article), research assistant (10), teaching assistant (8), fieldwork supervision (1 per week per student, max 12), manuscript review (max 12), auditing academic courses (max 12). Reading, business meetings and self-instruction without proficiency exam do not count. The Department does not approve courses or providers.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first license renewal.
rules.audit_note: No documents needed to renew; submit certificates within 45 days if the Department requests them. Keep records at least 3 years after the renewal due date.
rules.legal_basis: Conn. Gen. Stat. §20-74i; Regs. Conn. State Agencies §§20-74i-1 to 20-74i-8
rules.notes: Biennial renewal (fee $205); hours must be completed in the two-year period preceding renewal. Waivers for licensees not practicing (notarized form before the period ends) or for medical disability; after a disability waiver, 12 contact hours within 6 months of returning to practice.
rules.rule_quote: Pursuant to Connecticut General Statutes and the Regulations of Connecticut State Agencies ( RSA ), each licensee applying for license renewal shall complete a minimum of 24 contact hours of qualifying continued competency activity during the preceding two-year period for which the license is being renewed.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same qualifying activities and caps as for OTs (Regs. Conn. State Agencies §20-74i-3).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first license renewal.
rules.audit_note: No documents needed to renew; submit certificates within 45 days if the Department requests them. Keep records at least 3 years.
rules.legal_basis: Conn. Gen. Stat. §20-74i; Regs. Conn. State Agencies §§20-74i-1 to 20-74i-8
rules.notes: Hours must be completed in the two-year period preceding renewal.
rules.rule_quote: Pursuant to Connecticut General Statutes and the Regulations of Connecticut State Agencies ( RSA ), each licensee applying for license renewal shall complete a minimum of 18 contact hours of qualifying continued competency activity during the preceding two-year period for which the license is being renewed.
